trigger: False reconciliation of intent outcomes during forensic audit of order journals
root_cause: Matching order parameters (asset, side, qty, price) alone without temporal proximity and 1-to-1 consumption constraints permits later intents to falsely resolve earlier unmatched intents.
verified_remedy: Enforce 1-to-1 consumption across submissions and unmatched intents, and require sub-2-second causal timestamp alignment before attributing external intent records; preserve unaligned intents as genuinely UNKNOWN.
limitations: Requires synchronized host clocks between producer and audit journals within 2 seconds.
